# File Registration

Provide the URL for a previously uploaded file to receive an ID that can be used as the `reference_file_registration_id` in subsequent image generation requests.


Use of this endpoint is restricted to clients with a Fine Tune AI Generation license product.

## The File Registration Request

The `FileRegistrationRequest` payload accepts the following
parameters:

| Parameter           | Purpose

info.name: Get details on a registered file

params.name: fileRegistrationId
params.description: The id from a previous request to register a file

items.docs:
# Get Registered File Details

Gets details for a registered file.  This endpoint is used after a call to `POST beta/ai/file-registrations`, passing the `id` value from the result of that call.
